newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Arco wins Venezuelan Kaki oil contract.
newsitem.headline: Arco wins Venezuelan Kaki oil contract.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield (ARCO) in association with Venezuela's Inelectra and Polar Uno agreed Monday to pay $60 million for the contract to operate Venezuela's Kaki oil area, state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) said.
The Arco, Inelectra, Polar Uno consortium was among 14 bidders on the first day of Venezuela's third round of oil operating contract auctions.
A total of 131 companies are competing for 20 contracts and the winners are determined purely by the size of their cash bids.
Under the 20-year contract, the operator will produce hydrocarbons on behalf of PDVSA subsidiary Corpoven in exchange for a fee worked out on a sliding scale.

Discovered in 1957 in eastern Venezuela, Kaki was one of five areas reserved for Venezuelan operators with a minimum 30 percent stake. As a condition of the contract, the operator must invest at least $7 million within three years, although PDVSA expects investment to be higher.
